properties.name: BC Cancer – Prince George (Centre for the North)
properties.location_note: Verified facility at the official 1215 Lethbridge Street address. The returned OpenStreetMap clinic is named BC Cancer – Prince George (Centre for the North). The official postal code V2M 7E9 is retained; the Nominatim context postcode differs. This is distinct from the Vancouver BC Cancer agency record in PGMaps and from the adjacent University Hospital of Northern BC. Historical registry listings do not establish current recruitment, local enrollment or eligibility.
properties.location_precision: facility

properties.name: Prince George Family YMCA
properties.location_note: Verified operator address at 2020 Massey Drive. The returned OpenStreetMap sports-centre node is named YMCA of Northern BC and matches the street address, Prince George and postal code. A listed trial site does not establish local enrollment, eligibility or current recruitment.
properties.location_precision: facility

properties.name: Prince George Surgery Centre
properties.location_note: HealthLink BC explicitly locates Prince George Surgery Centre at 500 Victoria Street. The returned OpenStreetMap address node matches that building address and Prince George. PGMaps has the Surgery Centre at 500 Victoria St with a nearby BC Geocoder point marked for review; the official listing resolves that identity. The official postal code V2L 2J9 is retained; the Nominatim context postcode differs. This point represents the building, not a department or exact study room. UNKNOWN source study status is retained; no current recruitment is inferred.
properties.location_precision: facility
